description: This file defines a class RecipientTableConfigResolver that configures and resolves a table for displaying notification recipients, including fetching data, handling row clicks, and dialog interactions.

classes.name: RecipientTableConfigResolver

methods.description: Returns the table configuration when the route is activated.
